name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Set the focus ring to 6px wide with 7:1 contrast and no glow. This meets WCAG AAA for large text and keeps the ring visible on high-contrast backgrounds without relying on glow effects that can blur on low-resolution screens. The trade-off is slightly more space taken up by the ring, but that’s negligible compared to the clarity it provides for keyboard users.

name: Reader
text: The 6px ring risks failing users who need reduced motion—static rings can still trigger vestibular disorders if they appear abruptly. A 2px ring with a 200ms fade-in meets WCAG motion preferences while keeping the ring visible. Test with a screen reader user who has vestibular sensitivity to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Set the focus ring to 2px wide with a 200ms fade-in from 0% to 100% opacity. This meets WCAG AAA for reduced motion by avoiding abrupt appearance while keeping the ring visible for keyboard users. The trade-off is a thinner initial ring that may be harder to spot on high-contrast backgrounds, but the fade ensures it doesn’t trigger vestibular disorders.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks failing users with low vision or motor impairments who rely on high-contrast focus indicators. A 3px ring with a 100ms fade-in balances reduced motion with visibility. Test with a screen reader user who has low vision to settle the width.
